aspects.says: Persistence is layered as an entity, a repository whose query methods are derived from their names, and a service the rest of the server calls instead of the repository.
aspects.reason: it needs Spring Data JPA and a database, and a graded run has neither; the exercise keeps the service seam as a plain interface

aspects.says: A TransactionParticipant stores each transaction by turning its Context into a record and handing it to a service in prepare, and declares itself NO_JOIN and READONLY because it has nothing to commit or undo.
